audit.description: Changed production code in smartystreets_python_sdk/requests_sender.py imports real urllib3 APIs including PoolManager, ProxyManager, MaxRetryError, and HTTPResponse, and uses PoolManager/ProxyManager through self.pool.request. The diff removes requests imports from production code and replaces requests dependencies with urllib3 in requirements/setup metadata. Static and dynamic evidence show no source-library imports from production repo code, while urllib3 is observed from production repo code with origins in site-packages, and target_local_spec_count is 0.
evidence: diff smartystreets_python_sdk/requests_sender.py: replaces from requests import Session, Request with from urllib3 import PoolManager, ProxyManager plus urllib3.exceptions.MaxRetryError and urllib3.response.HTTPResponse
diff smartystreets_python_sdk/requests_sender.py: RequestsSender.__init__ builds self.pool and send() calls self.pool.request(...)
diff requirements.txt/setup.py/egg-info: dependency changed from requests to urllib3
static anti-cheat: smartystreets_python_sdk/requests_sender.py imports_target=true, imports_source=false; checked production Python files have imports_source=false and source_namespace_access=false
dynamic anti-cheat: target_events_from_production_repo_count=34, first target import from smartystreets_python_sdk/requests_sender.py line 17 resolves to site-packages/urllib3/__init__.py
reasons: production code meaningfully uses urllib3 request machinery
changed production code no longer imports or uses requests
urllib3 resolves to installed site-packages, not a local fake provider
source import attempts are only from dependency code, not repo production code
